acceptable_changes: Taxi logistics compressed to one sentence (optional unit).
Cut the batman 'come over queer' anecdote, the 'gorse won't be there' exchange and the Little William repeat on the path (all optional).
Condensed the French marriage digression and Tommy's 'Well, I'm damned!' interruption, keeping 'too damned businesslike' with the cold rebuke.
Removed Sir James's 'I hope so' exchange and several of Tommy's tongue-tied 'Oh!' beats, and merged adjacent lines by the same speaker.
Added compact attributions ('said Sir James', 'continued Julius', 'said Julius') where cuts removed context.
review_focus: Julius's merged speech joining the photo confession to 'cured', and whether the photo-mismatch ambiguity ('must be--because I recognized her') stays intact.
The one-sentence taxi bridge into the gorse-path dialogue.
The sympathetic-ink line merged with 'Heat usually does the trick' in one Tommy paragraph.
risks: Length was estimated by hand and may run slightly over the 1000-word target.
Tommy's narrated reflection that success seemed too easy was cut; his outburst remains.
summary: Abridgment of 'Too Late' that keeps all six verbatim excerpts, Sir James's two o'clock meeting and his warnings, the 24th, Little Willie, Julius's photo puzzlement, the marriage rebuke, the gorse, the boulder, the new stitches, the ink idea, and the ending taunt.
